questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for building and approving field/asset development plans integrating subsurface, drilling, facilities and economics?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether development plans are produced through a structured, cross-disciplinary, approved process, versus an informal document assembled by a single discipline.
questions.instruction_text: Review the development plan template/standard, evidence of cross-functional input (subsurface, drilling, facilities, finance, HSE), and the formal approval/sign-off record.
questions.evidence_examples: Development plan document and template; cross-functional review comments; management approval record; plan revision history.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if the current development plan has no documented cross-functional review or approval date.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for planning and executing seismic data acquisition campaigns (2D/3D/4D, land or marine crews and subcontractors)?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether seismic acquisition is run as a controlled, permitted, safety-managed operation with defined technical specifications, rather than an ad hoc field activity driven solely by the crew contractor.
questions.instruction_text: Review the acquisition program design (source/receiver geometry, fold, bin size), the permitting and HSE clearance trail, and how field QC (near-real-time noise/coverage monitoring) feeds back into acquisition parameters during the survey.
questions.evidence_examples: Acquisition design report; land/marine access permits and HSE clearances; daily field QC/observer reports; source and receiver test records; final acquisition report vs. program.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if surveys are routinely executed without a documented acquisition design or without any field QC/observer sign-off trail.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's management of laboratory services (core analysis, fluid PVT, geochemistry) supporting subsurface evaluation?
questions.question_intent: Determine whether lab services are quality-managed (accreditation, chain of custody, QC) or operate without traceable quality controls.
questions.instruction_text: Review lab accreditation/certification status, sample chain-of-custody records, and QC/calibration logs for lab equipment (internal lab or subcontracted).
questions.evidence_examples: Lab accreditation certificate; chain-of-custody forms; QC/calibration logs; lab results sign-off records.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if sample chain of custody cannot be reconstructed from receipt to reported result.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for performing reservoir imaging (velocity model building, migration, inversion) and ensuring quality of the resulting subsurface image?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether imaging workflows follow a controlled sequence with documented QC (especially well-tie validation), rather than being a black-box vendor deliverable.
questions.instruction_text: Review the imaging workflow documentation, velocity model build/update records, migration algorithm selection rationale, and well-tie QC reports for the most recent imaging project.
questions.evidence_examples: Velocity model iterations; migration/inversion parameter logs; well-tie QC reports; imaging sign-off memo.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if imaged volumes are delivered without a documented well-tie or velocity QC step.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's governance of seismic data assets (raw, processed, interpreted) across their lifecycle?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether seismic data is catalogued, versioned and access-controlled, avoiding loss, duplication or use of superseded volumes.
questions.instruction_text: Review the seismic data management system/catalogue, versioning conventions, license/ownership tracking for licensed or multi-client data, and backup/archival policy.
questions.evidence_examples: Seismic data catalogue export; data license register; backup/archival logs; naming/versioning standard document.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if there is no central catalogue and staff locate seismic volumes via personal folders or memory.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for delivering and controlling the quality of internal/external technical advisory input to E&P decisions?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether advisory input (internal experts or external consultants) is scoped, documented and tracked to decisions, versus informal, undocumented advice.
questions.instruction_text: Review advisory engagement terms of reference, deliverable documentation, and traceability between advisory recommendations and subsequent decisions.
questions.evidence_examples: Advisory engagement scope/contract; advisory deliverable/report; decision record referencing advisory input.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if significant technical decisions reference undocumented or unattributed advisory input.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's coordination of the broader set of reservoir engineering services (well test analysis, material balance, production forecasting) supporting field management?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether reservoir services are delivered through a coordinated, documented workflow linked to field management decisions, rather than isolated one-off analyses.
questions.instruction_text: Review the reservoir services work program, linkage of well test/material balance outputs to production forecasts, and how forecasts are reconciled against actual production.
questions.evidence_examples: Reservoir services work program; well test/material balance reports; production forecast vs. actual reconciliation.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if production forecasts are not periodically reconciled against actual production data.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for building, running and controlling reservoir simulation models used to support development decisions?
questions.question_intent: Determine whether simulation models are version-controlled, history-matched and validated before being used for decisions, versus used as unchecked black boxes.
questions.instruction_text: Review model build documentation, history-match reports, sensitivity/uncertainty runs, and the approval step before a model is used to support a business decision.
questions.evidence_examples: Model documentation report; history-match QC package; run log/version register; decision memo referencing simulation output.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if simulation outputs feed investment decisions without a documented history-match or peer review.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's control over seismic data processing (in-house or subcontracted), from raw field data to final processed volume?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether processing sequences and parameters are specified, QC'd and signed off, rather than accepted as delivered from a vendor without review.
questions.instruction_text: Review the processing flow specification, intermediate QC checkpoints, and the final acceptance/sign-off record against the contracted specification.
questions.evidence_examples: Processing sequence/parameter document; intermediate QC reports; vendor deliverable acceptance sign-off; processing contract specification.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if processed volumes are accepted without comparing deliverables against the contracted processing specification.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for translating subsurface interpretation into reserves estimates and economic evaluations?
questions.question_intent: Determine whether reserves/economics work follows a controlled, auditable methodology consistent with recognized standards (e.g., SPE-PRMS), versus informal spreadsheet-based estimates.
questions.instruction_text: Review the reserves estimation methodology document, the economic model assumptions register (price deck, cost basis), and the internal/external audit trail for reserves bookings.
questions.evidence_examples: Reserves estimation methodology; economic model assumption register; reserves audit report; sign-off record for reserves bookings.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if reserves figures used externally have no traceable link to an approved estimation methodology or audit.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's overall survey management (scope definition, contractor selection, mobilization/demobilization, HSE oversight) for seismic surveys?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether survey execution is managed as a project with defined scope, budget, schedule and HSE oversight, rather than delegated wholesale to the contractor.
questions.instruction_text: Review the survey scope of work, contractor selection/evaluation records, mobilization plan, and HSE incident/near-miss tracking specific to the survey.
questions.evidence_examples: Survey scope of work; contractor bid evaluation; mobilization/demobilization plan; survey HSE statistics.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if survey HSE performance is not tracked separately from general company HSE statistics.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's process for conducting integrated geophysical studies (gravity, magnetics, EM, multi-attribute analysis) beyond core seismic imaging?
questions.question_intent: Determine whether geophysical studies are scoped against a specific technical question with documented conclusions, or performed opportunistically without a clear deliverable.
questions.instruction_text: Review study terms of reference, integration of geophysical results with geological/petrophysical data, and the study close-out report.
questions.evidence_examples: Study terms of reference; integrated interpretation report; peer review comments; study close-out/recommendations memo.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if geophysical studies are commissioned without a documented terms of reference defining the question to be answered.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's use of remote sensing data (satellite imagery, aeromagnetic/aerogravity surveys) to support exploration and site planning?
questions.question_intent: Assess whether remote sensing data is systematically integrated into planning workflows or used only sporadically on an individual analyst's initiative.
questions.instruction_text: Review how remote sensing datasets are sourced, archived, and integrated with site planning, environmental baseline and exploration targeting workflows.
questions.evidence_examples: Remote sensing data inventory; integration reports with exploration/site-planning workflows; environmental baseline studies referencing remote sensing data.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if remote sensing data used for environmental baselining is not archived or traceable to a source/date.

questions.question_text: How mature is the organization's end-to-end quality control of the final seismic imaging product delivered to interpreters and decision-makers?
questions.question_intent: Distinguish this from 'Perform reservoir imaging' (technical workflow) by focusing on the governance step: formal acceptance, distribution control and versioning of the final imaged product used across the organization.
questions.instruction_text: Review the final imaging product acceptance checklist, distribution list/access control, and the linkage between the accepted version and downstream interpretation projects.
questions.evidence_examples: Final product acceptance checklist; distribution/access log; interpretation project references to a specific imaging version.
questions.alert_rule_hint: Flag if more than one 'final' version of an imaged volume circulates without a clear designation of the authoritative version.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Development plans are informal, produced by one discipline with no cross-functional input.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A basic template exists; cross-functional input is sought inconsistently.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A documented process requires cross-functional review and management approval for every development plan.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Development plans are revisited on a defined cadence and revised based on new data/performance, with tracked revision history.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Development planning is integrated with portfolio and economic optimization tools, with scenario/sensitivity analysis routinely informing plan revisions.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Request the approval record for the current development plan and confirm all required disciplines signed prior to approval date.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Development plan document and template; cross-functional review comments; management approval record; plan revision history.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Verify the plan's revision history shows updates tied to specific triggers (new well data, price changes, performance review).
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if the current development plan has no documented cross-functional review or approval date.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Acquisition is subcontracted with minimal specification; there is no documented acquisition design and field QC is verbal/ad hoc.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A basic acquisition design (geometry, fold) is produced per survey, but permitting/HSE clearance and field QC records are inconsistently kept.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: Acquisition design, permitting and field QC are documented and approved for every survey, following an internal standard.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Acquisition parameters are actively adjusted mid-survey based on real-time QC data, and post-survey performance (fold, S/N, cost vs. budget) is systematically reviewed against the design.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Acquisition planning integrates lessons learned and rock-physics/imaging feedback across campaigns, with predictive parameter optimization and continuous benchmarking of crew/contractor performance.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Request the last three acquisition design reports and match them against field QC logs and the final acquisition report; confirm sign-off dates precede mobilization.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Acquisition design report; land/marine access permits and HSE clearances; daily field QC/observer reports; source and receiver test records; final acquisition report vs. program.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Confirm existence of design→permit→field QC→close-out report chain; sample one survey end to end; check for design deviations that were never re-approved.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if surveys are routinely executed without a documented acquisition design or without any field QC/observer sign-off trail.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Lab work is commissioned with no chain-of-custody records or quality certification requirement.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: Some chain-of-custody documentation exists but is incomplete or inconsistently applied.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: Chain of custody, QC/calibration and accreditation requirements are documented and enforced for all lab work.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Lab performance (turnaround, QC pass rate, inter-lab comparison) is tracked and used in vendor selection.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Laboratory quality management is integrated into an organization-wide data quality program, with continuous inter-laboratory benchmarking.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Request the chain-of-custody record for a recent core/fluid sample and trace it from field collection to final lab report.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Lab accreditation certificate; chain-of-custody forms; QC/calibration logs; lab results sign-off records.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Confirm lab accreditation certificates are current and cover the specific analyses being relied upon.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if sample chain of custody cannot be reconstructed from receipt to reported result.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Imaging is outsourced with no internal review of velocity models or well ties.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: Velocity models exist but updates are undocumented; well-tie QC is occasional.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A standard workflow (velocity build → migration → well-tie QC → sign-off) is documented and followed.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Imaging quality metrics (well-tie residuals, resolution) are tracked over time and used to select algorithms/vendors.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Imaging workflows are continuously benchmarked, with feedback loops from drilling results used to refine velocity models for future campaigns.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Ask for the well-tie QC report for the most recent imaging project and confirm it was reviewed before the volume was released to interpreters.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Velocity model iterations; migration/inversion parameter logs; well-tie QC reports; imaging sign-off memo.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Trace one imaging deliverable from raw processed volume to sign-off; verify well-tie residual is documented and within stated tolerance.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if imaged volumes are delivered without a documented well-tie or velocity QC step.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Seismic volumes are stored on individual workstations/shared drives with no catalogue or version control.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A shared repository exists but cataloguing is incomplete and versioning is informal.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A documented catalogue with versioning, licensing status and access rights is maintained and kept current.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Data management is audited periodically; usage/access is logged and license compliance is actively monitored.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Seismic data governance is integrated with the broader subsurface data management strategy, with automated lifecycle policies (archival, purge, license expiry alerts).
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Request an export of the seismic catalogue and cross-check three volumes against physical/electronic storage to confirm accuracy.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Seismic data catalogue export; data license register; backup/archival logs; naming/versioning standard document.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Verify catalogue completeness against a sample of known surveys; check license expiry tracking for at least one multi-client dataset.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if there is no central catalogue and staff locate seismic volumes via personal folders or memory.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Advisory input is informal and undocumented; no scope or deliverable trail exists.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: Formal engagements exist for major consultants but internal advisory input is not documented.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: All significant advisory engagements (internal or external) have a documented scope and deliverable, referenced in decisions.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Advisory input quality/value is periodically assessed against decision outcomes.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Advisory sourcing is optimized through a maintained registry of internal/external expertise with performance tracking and knowledge capture.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Ask for the terms of reference and deliverable of the most recent significant advisory engagement and confirm it is referenced in a decision record.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Advisory engagement scope/contract; advisory deliverable/report; decision record referencing advisory input.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Trace one major technical decision back to the advisory input that supported it.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if significant technical decisions reference undocumented or unattributed advisory input.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Reservoir services are performed reactively with no coordinated work program.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A work program exists but forecast-vs-actual reconciliation is infrequent or undocumented.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A documented work program coordinates reservoir services, with regular forecast reconciliation against actuals.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Forecast accuracy trends are tracked and used to refine reservoir models and service prioritization.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Reservoir services are fully integrated with production surveillance and asset planning, with predictive analytics driving proactive interventions.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Ask for the latest production forecast reconciliation report and confirm variance analysis was documented and acted upon.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Reservoir services work program; well test/material balance reports; production forecast vs. actual reconciliation.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Confirm the reservoir services work program is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence (e.g., quarterly).
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if production forecasts are not periodically reconciled against actual production data.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Simulation models are built ad hoc with no documentation or history-match evidence.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: Models are documented but history-matching and peer review are inconsistent.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A standard model-build and history-match/QC process is documented and applied before model use.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Uncertainty/sensitivity analysis is routinely performed and version history of the model is fully traceable.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Simulation practice is benchmarked and continuously improved using production surveillance feedback, with automated history-match tooling.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Ask for the history-match report of the model currently used for the active field development plan and confirm it was peer-reviewed.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Model documentation report; history-match QC package; run log/version register; decision memo referencing simulation output.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Confirm model version referenced in the latest development decision matches an approved, dated history-match package.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if simulation outputs feed investment decisions without a documented history-match or peer review.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Processing is fully outsourced with no internal specification or QC of deliverables.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A basic specification exists but intermediate QC checkpoints are rarely reviewed internally.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: Processing flow, QC checkpoints and final acceptance are documented and followed for every project.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Processing performance (turnaround, QC metrics) is tracked across vendors/projects and used in vendor selection.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Processing parameter libraries and QC benchmarks are continuously refined from project experience, with reprocessing decisions driven by quantified imaging uplift.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Request the QC sign-off record for the last processing project and verify it references the contracted specification.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Processing sequence/parameter document; intermediate QC reports; vendor deliverable acceptance sign-off; processing contract specification.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Sample one processing deliverable and confirm each contracted QC checkpoint has a corresponding signed record.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if processed volumes are accepted without comparing deliverables against the contracted processing specification.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Reserves/economics are estimated informally with no documented methodology or assumption register.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: A methodology exists but is applied inconsistently; assumptions are not centrally tracked.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: A documented, PRMS-aligned methodology is applied consistently, with a maintained assumption register and sign-off.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Reserves estimates undergo periodic independent audit and variance analysis against actuals.
maturity_statements.level_5_leading: Reserves/economics processes are continuously calibrated against production and price outcomes, with full traceability from raw data to booked reserves.
maturity_statements.assessor_instruction: Ask for the most recent reserves audit report and confirm findings were tracked to closure.
maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Reserves estimation methodology; economic model assumption register; reserves audit report; sign-off record for reserves bookings.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Trace one reserves category booking back to its supporting interpretation and assumption set.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if reserves figures used externally have no traceable link to an approved estimation methodology or audit.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Survey scope is loosely defined and contractor performance is not tracked.

maturity_statements.level_3_established: Scope, contractor selection criteria and HSE oversight are documented and applied for every survey.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Survey performance (cost, schedule, HSE, data quality) is tracked and benchmarked across contractors and campaigns.

maturity_statements.level_1_basic: Studies are performed without a defined terms of reference or documented conclusions.
maturity_statements.level_2_developing: Terms of reference exist for major studies only; peer review is inconsistent.
maturity_statements.level_3_established: All studies have a documented terms of reference, are peer-reviewed, and produce a close-out report with recommendations.
maturity_statements.level_4_advanced: Study recommendations are tracked to implementation and their value (e.g., risk reduction, well placement improvement) is assessed.

maturity_statements.evidence_examples: Study terms of reference; integrated interpretation report; peer review comments; study close-out/recommendations memo.
maturity_statements.review_steps: Confirm peer review sign-off exists and recommendations are referenced in a subsequent decision document.
maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if geophysical studies are commissioned without a documented terms of reference defining the question to be answered.

maturity_statements.level_3_established: A documented process defines when and how remote sensing data is acquired, archived and integrated into planning.

maturity_statements.alert_rule_hint: Flag if remote sensing data used for environmental baselining is not archived or traceable to a source/date.
